summary: Midland States Bancorp filed an 8-K to announce routine quarterly dividends: a $0.33 per common share cash dividend (3.1% increase from $0.32) payable August 21, 2026, and a $0.4844 per depositary share preferred dividend payable September 30, 2026. This is ordinary capital return, not a special-situation event. No deal terms apply; watch for continued dividend growth as earnings improve.
